name: What is the typical process for optimizing a local marketing agency's website?
description: The process involves an audit, keyword research, technical fixes, local content optimization, GMB enhancement, and ongoing monitoring and updates.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for optimizing a local marketing agency's website?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with a comprehensive audit of the website's technical SEO, local SEO, content, and user experience. Following this, keyword research identifies local search terms and competitor analysis is performed. Implementation involves technical fixes, content optimization with local relevance, and Google My Business profile enhancements. Ongoing efforts include performance monitoring, regular content updates, link building, and adapting strategies based on search algorithm changes and performance data to ensure continuous improvement.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an audit, keyword research, technical fixes, local content optimization, GMB enhancement, and ongoing monitoring and updates.
